Ed Bassmaster is a comedian, content creator, and prankster best known for his wildly popular YouTube channel, where he brings an eccentric cast of characters to life. Born and raised in Philadelphia, Ed developed a love for comedy at an early age, drawing inspiration from classic pranksters and observational humor.

In 2006, he launched his YouTube channel, quickly gaining a loyal following with his offbeat sketches, hidden camera pranks, and hilarious character-driven videos. Over the years, he has amassed over 2.8 million subscribers and hundreds of millions of views, making him one of the internet's most recognizable pranksters. His iconic personas—such as Skippy, Teste, Mumbles, Bushman, and the "Would You Look at That" guy—have become viral sensations, with fans quoting his catchphrases worldwide.
Ed's success on YouTube led to mainstream recognition, including appearances on major TV networks and his own reality-comedy series,
on CMT. He has collaborated with brands, fellow comedians, and social media stars, cementing his place as a pioneer in digital comedy.

Witz Comedy Network is a digital studio creating content for its fast channel, AVOD/SVOD library, and podcast platform. Founded and operated by the same team that brought you The Stand Comedy Club. For a decade and a half, The Stand has been a staple of the New York comedy scene by hosting A-list comedians and becoming a home to the genre's funniest performers as well as the best comedy fans. Headed up by brothers Cris Italia, Paul Italia, and Patrick Milligan, The Stand also operates a management and production company, representing some of the best names in comedy while producing for TV and film. Due to their success at The Stand, they were tapped as stand-up comedy bookers for The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon in 2015 and have collaborated with Just for Laughs and SXSW festivals. Their produced comedy specials and series have been featured on HBO, Netflix, Tubi, Showtime, among many other streamers and on-demand platforms. The Stand created Witz Comedy Network to deliver an elevated experience for comedy fans. Witz can be found as a FAST Channel on most platforms. Witz's library is distributed on Amazon, LG, Xumo, Plex and many more.
